claim.claim-text: 1. Method of operating a user equipment (10) in a radio access network, the method comprising transmitting feedback control signaling, the feedback control signaling representing a number I of information bits, wherein the I information bits are encoded with a code rate based on a code rate indication.

2. User equipment (10) for a radio access network, the user equipment (10) being adapted for transmitting feedback control signaling, the feedback control signaling representing a number I of information bits, wherein the I information bits are encoded with a code rate based on a code rate indication.

3. Method of operating a configuring radio node (100) in a radio access network, wherein the method comprises configuring a user equipment (10) with a code rate indication for feedback control signaling, the code rate indication indicating a code rate for encoding information bits of the feedback control signaling.

4. Configuring radio node (100) for a radio access network, the configuring radio node (100) being adapted for configuring a user equipment (10) with a code rate indication for feedback control signaling, the code rate indication indicating a code rate for encoding information bits of the feedback control signaling.
5. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the code rate indication indicates a bandwidth for the feedback signaling.

6. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the code rate and/or code rate indication is determined based on a transmission mode and/or a representation thereof, e.g. of signaling to which the feedback control signaling pertains.

7. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the code rate indication indicates an anchor frequency resource structure and/or indicates a bandwidth, and/or a bandwidth location or distribution, for the feedback control signaling.
8. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the code rate indication indicates one of a plurality of code rates possible for a coding scheme.
9. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the code rate indication indicates one of a plurality of code rates possible for I information bits.
10. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein a code rate is indicated by a number L of coding bits to be determined based on I information bits.
11. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the code rate indication indicates and/or represents a target block error rate for the feedback control signaling.
12. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the feedback control signaling is associated to a physical uplink control channel or a physical sidelink control channel.
13. Method or device according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the feedback control signaling represents uplink control information or sidelink control information.
14. Program product comprising instructions causing processing circuitry to control and/or perform a method according to one of claims 1, 3 or 5 to 13.
15. Carrier medium arrangement carrying and/or storing a program product according to claim 14.
